name: AirOps
description: Access your workspaces, Brand Kits, and AEO analytics

_published_faq.name: How do I add AirOps to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add AirOps to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://app.airops.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the AirOps MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: AirOps provides these MCP tools: list_workspaces, list_brand_kits, get_brand_kit, list_brand_kit_competitors, list_personas, list_topics, list_aeo_prompts, get_prompt_answers, query_analytics, list_pages, get_page_details, and get_page_prompts.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to AirOps?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to AirOps in marketing-seo on the Manufact MCP catalog include Buzzfy, Airefs AI Visibility, TalkGenAI, RankControl, and attentive-mcp-server.
AirOps requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
AirOps is developed by AirOps. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
